title: Felix and the Rainbow Quest
moral: Imagination can turn simple moments into magical adventures.

scenes.summary: Felix decides to go on an adventure to find Rainbow Lake.

story: Felix the fox imagined going on a big adventure to find the magical Rainbow Lake. He met Ollie the owl, who joined him. Together they followed a stream and found a shiny rainbow pebble. The pebble helped guide them along a sparkling path. Soon, they discovered the beautiful Rainbow Lake shining with many colors. Felix felt proud and happy. They sat together and enjoyed the magical place, dreaming of more adventures to come.
